_comment: This project's own config. It is the SINGLE-REPO case — one repo owning the workspace root, no
siblings, nothing to pin — which is precisely the case a multi-repo workspace can never exercise
that decides whether 'reusable' is real rather than aspirational (founding design §8).
Phase 3 (self-hosting: own graph, own gate) builds on this; declaring the topology is just the
tool saying what it is, and the entrypoints refuse to guess without it.
_exclude_comment: fixtures/ holds two COMPLETE synthetic projects — REQ-1's oracle. They carry their own
CLAUDE.md, .github/system-design specs and requirements, and deliberately-broken cases (a
dangling reference, an orphan doc) that exist to be asserted against. Without this they are
indexed as OUR knowledge: 'main:claude' collides with the real CLAUDE.md, and the fixtures'
defects are reported as this project's own issues.
